preconditions.description: The input is a single integer x where 1 ≤ x ≤ 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip().count(' ') == 1 and (a := int(stdout.strip().split()[0])) and (b := int(stdout.strip().split()[1])) and 1 <= a <= x and 1 <= b <= x and a % b == 0 and a * b > x and a / b < x)
postconditions.description: If no valid pair (a, b) exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains two integers a and b separated by a space such that 1 ≤ a, b ≤ x, b divides a (a % b == 0), a * b > x, and a / b < x.
